description:
Returns a Client's Chases across Quarters — when they finished and how many days early or late against the date they were asked to send by (and whether before or after the HMRC deadline) — with a one-line summary. Without a client, returns every active Client ranked by how late they usually are.
Use this when: asked whether a Client is usually late, how they did last time, or who's always late.
Not for: who hasn't sent records this Quarter (whos_outstanding).
